'''Egan Garrud''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Corellian Security Force]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CorSecCaptainFemale.png|thumb|left|130px|A female depiction of Egan Garrud, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Egan Garrud was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Egan Garrud spawned under the generic "corsec_captain" template, his appearance was randomized under one of two possible depictions. He could either appear as a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|haired]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Human male, or as a brown haired, brown eyed Human female. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Garrud as male, this article assumes that the Human male depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. Furthermore, examining the NPC revealed his name to be '''Egan Garud''', without two "Rs" in the surname. This article assumes "Garrud" to be the correct spelling, as it was consistently used in the quest dialogue.<ref name="AED" />
